title: Supply of forms
html:
Supply of Forms

336. Forms of Drafts and all other forms prescribed by the Reserve Bank for use in connexion with the remittances dealt with in this Chapter will be supplied to the Treasury Officer by the Currency Officer under whose jurisdiction the Treasury is situated. Indents for such supplies will be in Form T. R. 68 or in such other form as the Reserve Bank may prescribe and will ordinarily be for twelve month’s supply.
